title: FraudCleared
description: The fraud detection service publishes FraudCleared when its risk assessment clears an authorized transaction, and the notification service reads it under the notification-fraud consumer group. No source program assesses risk, so this event is additive in full and has no COBOL ancestor: its three payload fields and five envelope fields translate no source record. card-platform/docs/event-flow.md shows where this event travels, and card-platform/docs/decision-log.md holds the rationale for every choice in this document. Evolution is additive only: additionalProperties stays true, so a consumer validating against this version accepts an event that carries a field added by a later version. Inside one version no field is removed, renamed, retyped or narrowed; a change of that kind takes a new schemaVersion and a new -v<n> document beside this one.
$comment: The wire form is flat: the five envelope fields and the three payload fields sit in one object. A payload nesting the envelope under an envelope key fails this document.

eventId.description: The idempotency key, a lower-case canonical Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of thirty-six characters. Each consumer records this identifier before it applies side effects. The pattern is asserted directly, so validation does not depend on the validator enabling the optional format-assertion vocabulary. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer on the fraud.assessed topic reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. This file is version 1, matching the -v1 suffix in its name. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The fraud detection service stamps it when it writes the event, and assessedAt carries the time the assessment finished. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits, and always the Kafka message key. Width from XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. The Kafka message key, this field and the payload field accountId all carry one value, so account identity has a single source. A publisher compares the key against both fields and rejects the message on any difference.

transactionId.description: The identifier of the transaction the assessment cleared, sixteen characters. Width borrowed from TRAN-ID PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy:L5, so the value matches the transactionId on TransactionAuthorized.

accountId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits. Width borrowed from XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. A text field keeps a leading zero, and a consumer maps this field onto its own account column.

assessedAt.description: The time the assessment finished, in Coordinated Universal Time. Additive. No source field exists.
